author: MLG_Jirafa
body:
I'm getting really tired of the staff trying to keep the chat clean and perfect, but we are not childs, first of all swearing should be allowed (and no It's not allowed, checked in the rules).
Then you should not warn EVERYONE in chat at the end of a game just because of the hackusations/spam/language, just talk in general, not telling player by player what to do.
Also if there is even more mods (because we have a wave of 20+ Jr mods) the same message is repeating over and over.
Hackusating: if someone says "hacks" without mention anyone, then don't say anything, because it's not hackusating and it's not punishable.
Reporting: if someone has reported a randy for hacking, and then he accuse in chat, then why do you tell him to /report
Hacking in general: priorities on these ones please, if you are spectating someone hacking, do not warn players in chat about something small, basic logic, I mean like you are spectating to be invisible and keep track of the player, there is no need to show yourself in the chat like that.
The same goes with the salutes, saying "hi sir mod" shouldn't be allowed if the staff member is spectating,if they are playing then no problem.

replies.author: JKawesome
replies.body:
Ok, guys, this is how it works:
If someone swears when the fall into the void or something, that's fine. It's perfectly allowed. If someone gets killed and swears at the person who killed them, then that's not acceptable. You can swear a little, that's fine. You just can't swear excessively, or curse at someone.
